audit.whatIsWrong: The whole content layer describes a pre-rework Aurelion Sol: 'Voice of Light', 'Comet of Legend', 'orbiting stars', and Singularity called an escape tool. None of those exist in his current kit.
audit.why: Riot's data gives Cosmic Creator (P, Stardust), Breath of Light (Q, 3s, 750, a channel), Astral Flight (W, 22/20.5/19/17.5/16, 1500, flies over terrain), Singularity (E, 12s, 750, a black hole that pulls, does percent-health damage and executes below a threshold) and Falling Star / The Skies Descend (R, 120/110/100, 1250, stun). The escape is Astral Flight, not Singularity.
audit.corrected: Every fabricated name replaced with the real one across whys, spikes, early, late and wants.

audit.whatIsWrong: Difficulty prose never used the one number that decides when to commit.
audit.why: Astral Flight is 22s at rank 1 and only 16s at rank 5; while it is down he cannot cross terrain and cannot leave your 600-range W.
LeBlanc spikes at 2, 6 and first item; his are Stardust-driven rather than level-driven, which is why the 2+ items row belongs to him.
audit.corrected: Kept; phases[6] now says so in Stardust terms.

audit.whatIsWrong: breakdown.cooldowns had no digits and missed the two interactions that decide fights.
audit.why: Breath of Light and Astral Flight are channels, so Ethereal Chains — or a Mimic'd chain — cancels them outright. Singularity executes below a health threshold and deals percent-health damage, so armour and MR are the wrong answer to it.
audit.corrected: Rewritten with 22s/16s W, 12s E and the 3s Q channel, plus the cancel and the execute.

audit.whatIsWrong: phases[6].side read 'Skill' while content win[6] read 'Aurelion Sol'.
audit.why: packet.levelChart gives the 2+ items row to Aurelion Sol, matching the content layer; the full layer was the outlier and its why described LeBlanc winning the row.
audit.corrected: Row 6 flipped to Aurelion Sol with a matching why. Rows 0-5 already agreed across layers and were left alone.

edits.before: - Aurelion Sol Astral Flight: matchup-defining — His reposition and escape — he is a stationary battery while it is down. Count it out loud if you must. - Your W Distortion (return) has one job: the moment it all goes wrong. - The R has one too: the moment it all goes right.
edits.after: - Astral Flight (W): 22s at rank 1, 16s at rank 5 — while it is down he cannot leave. - Singularity is 12s and executes below a health threshold, so never sit in the black hole. - Breath of Light is a 3s channel and your Chains cancel it outright. - Your Distortion is 15s at rank 1.

edits.before: Q the sigil, W the detonation, return before the answer — a half-bar round trip he experienced as weather.
edits.after: Breath of Light is a channel — a chain or a Mimic'd chain cuts it mid-cast and costs him the whole rotation.

edits.before: Staying at the W landing spot for one more auto — the return timer is your champion; outliving it is optional.
edits.after: Cosmic Creator makes every cast he lands permanent power — a lead you sit on funds his Stardust, not your win.

edits.before: Trade into his one CC spell
Linger past the W return window. Trade into his one CC spell. Coast — your lead has a sell-by date. And keep the ultimate holstered until a kill is actually on the table.
edits.after: Linger past the W return window. Trade into his Falling Star. Coast — your lead has a sell-by date. And keep the ultimate holstered until a kill is actually on the table.

edits.before: W-poke the wave contacts and return before his answer — distortion math is the whole champion.
edits.after: W-poke the contacts and return before Singularity lands — Distortion math is the whole champion.

edits.before: Late LeBlanc picks: W the flank, chain the carry, mimic the exit — and vanish before the obituary prints.
edits.after: Stardust makes his Breath of Light and Singularity permanent scaling; one flank angle no longer removes him.

edits.before: LeBlanc's ability to dodge Voice of Light with her mobility keeps her ahead through the mid-game.
edits.after: LeBlanc's Distortion dodges Breath of Light's channel and keeps her ahead through the mid-game.

edits.before: LeBlanc's mobility and burst let her dive in and punish Aurelion Sol before he has stars stacked or Comet of Legend charged.
edits.after: LeBlanc's mobility and burst let her dive in and punish Aurelion Sol before Cosmic Creator has banked any Stardust for him.

edits.before: LeBlanc's doubled Chains root shuts down his Voice of Light poke and lets her burst him before he can Singularity-pull and follow up.
edits.after: LeBlanc's doubled Chains root cancels his Breath of Light channel and lets her burst him before Singularity can pull her in.

edits.before: Aurelion Sol's Voice of Light stun combined with Singularity's pull threatens to lock LeBlanc down for a big trade if she engages carelessly.
edits.after: Aurelion Sol's Falling Star stun combined with Singularity's pull threatens to lock LeBlanc down for a big trade if she engages carelessly.

edits.before: A scaled Aurelion Sol turns into an unkillable poke-and-zone machine whose stars deal absurd sustained AoE damage that outlasts LeBlanc's burst.
edits.after: A scaled Aurelion Sol turns into an unkillable poke-and-zone machine whose Stardust-fed Breath of Light outlasts anything LeBlanc's burst can do.

edits.before: LeBlanc dominates the early lane because Aurelion Sol is slow, has no hard escape, and his stars deal minimal damage until they stack up over time, meaning LeBlanc can dive in with W-E-Q and punish him severely. She should abuse her mobility to dodge his Voice of Light stun and continually threaten all-ins whenever his cooldowns are down. Aurelion Sol is stuck farming passively, hoping his stars grow strong enough to poke back.
edits.after: LeBlanc dominates the early lane because Aurelion Sol is slow, Astral Flight is 22 seconds at rank 1, and Breath of Light needs a long channel to hurt, meaning LeBlanc can dive in with W-E-Q and punish him severely. She should abuse her mobility to break that channel and continually threaten all-ins whenever his cooldowns are down. Aurelion Sol is stuck farming passively, hoping Stardust stacks fast enough to poke back.

edits.before: Once Aurelion Sol gets a couple of items and his stars grow massive, he becomes an incredibly safe and oppressive poke-and-zone mage whose Voice of Light and orbiting stars can shred anyone who approaches, all while Singularity gives him an escape and pull tool. LeBlanc's burst combo requires getting in range, which is exactly where his stars punish her hardest, and if her all-in whiffs she has no follow-up. This makes the late-game teamfight and skirmish phase favor Aurelion Sol's safer, scaling kit.
edits.after: Once Aurelion Sol gets a couple of items and Stardust piles up, he becomes an incredibly safe and oppressive poke-and-zone mage whose Breath of Light and Singularity can shred anyone who approaches, all while Astral Flight gives him a 1500-range escape over terrain. LeBlanc's burst combo requires getting in range, which is exactly where the black hole punishes her hardest, and if her all-in whiffs she has no follow-up. This makes the late-game teamfight and skirmish phase favor Aurelion Sol's safer, scaling kit.

edits.before: Dodge Voice of Light poke with W
edits.after: Dodge Breath of Light poke with W
Farm safely with Breath of Light

notes: This matchup's content layer was written for the OLD Aurelion Sol — 'Voice of Light', 'Comet of Legend' and 'orbiting stars' are all pre-rework, and Singularity was described as his escape when the escape is Astral Flight. All of those are corrected here. Worth checking whether other leblanc/aurelionsol-era pages in the lane carry the same stale kit.
